reuse.why: Puts the check in accounts/link.ts beside the existing findOrCreateBank and applies it to all five link handlers through one wrapper, without touching the five link functions' bodies.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; each registration restates the provider literal that its link function also hard-codes as account_sync_source, a small second source of truth.

placement.why: The query lives in link.ts with other linking helpers, but the guard is attached at app.method registration rather than inside the link path, so any direct caller of a linkXAccount function skips it.

scope.why: Only the guard, its wiring for the five link requests and its tests.

maintainability.why: One assertion function with a clear name and a generic wrapper is easy to own; a new provider must remember to wrap its registration and keep the provider string in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five *-accounts-link registrations go through refuseIfBankAccountLinked / link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is a single query.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, applied by refuseIfBankAccountLinked in accounts/app.ts to the gocardless, simplefin, pluggyai, akahu and enablebanking link requests.
